label: 本地工作区 MCP
description: Offline workspace tools for listing directories and reading text files
notes: Offline native MCP managed by the Windows startup script

label: radare2 MCP
description: Local radare2 MCP server for reverse and pwn binary analysis
notes: Uses launcher script to inject radare2 DLL search path before starting r2mcp.exe.

label: Ghidra MCP
description: Local Ghidra MCP bridge for reverse and pwn static analysis
notes: Uses the local GhidraMCP bridge against the running Ghidra plugin on http://127.0.0.1:8080/.

label: IDA 9.1 MCP Bridge
description: IDA 9.1 MCP plugin bridge exposed from the local IDA process
notes: Backed by IDA 9.1 plugin mcp-plugin.py. Scope is prewired for reverse/pwn; enable only after IDA starts the bridge on port 13337.

label: x64dbg MCP
description: Local x64dbg MCP bridge for live Windows debugging
notes: Prewired for reverse/pwn. Enable after x64dbg + HTTP plugin are up on http://127.0.0.1:8888/.
